title: Grafana Loki：標籤基數與租戶公平預算
titleEn: Grafana Loki: label cardinality and tenant fairness budgets
subcategoryTitle: 遙測管線、完整性與資料契約
subcategoryTitleEn: Telemetry pipelines, integrity and data contracts
summary: 列出穩定標籤與高變動欄位，為兩個租戶建立每日串流基數及稽核可搜尋性對照。
summaryEn: Separate stable labels from high-churn fields and compare daily stream cardinality with audit searchability for two tenants.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「標籤與事件欄位」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Labels versus event fields: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 將高基數移出標籤後仍須能查到事件ID；把欄位直接刪除雖省資源，卻破壞證據關聯。
以保留原始欄位及選定結構化中繼資料降低索引負擔，另測租戶隔離，不把低基數當授權控制。
Loki以標籤集合識別串流；將請求ID升成標籤可能讓索引與記憶體成本失控。
optionsEn: Moving high-cardinality fields out of labels must preserve ID searchability; deleting them destroys evidence correlation.
Reduce indexing pressure while retaining raw fields and selected structured metadata; low cardinality is not tenant authorization.
Loki identifies streams by label sets; promoting request IDs to labels can multiply index and memory pressure.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Loki以標籤集合識別串流；將請求ID升成標籤可能讓索引與記憶體成本失控。
knowledge.textEn: Loki identifies streams by label sets; promoting request IDs to labels can multiply index and memory pressure.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 列出穩定標籤與高變動欄位，為兩個租戶建立每日串流基數及稽核可搜尋性對照。
knowledge.textEn: Separate stable labels from high-churn fields and compare daily stream cardinality with audit searchability for two tenants.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 完全組合的上界是各標籤取值數乘積；實際基數需由觀察集合計數，不可把上界當實測。
knowledge.textEn: The Cartesian-product upper bound multiplies label cardinalities; observed stream counts require actual distinct tuples.

stages.title: 標籤與事件欄位
stages.description: Loki以標籤集合識別串流；將請求ID升成標籤可能讓索引與記憶體成本失控。 列出穩定標籤與高變動欄位，為兩個租戶建立每日串流基數及稽核可搜尋性對照。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 先產生完整10×4×3標籤笛卡兒積，逐組給一個日誌事件，再產生每組200個request_id版本。將查詢用request_id保留在事件內容或適當結構化中繼資料，並保留原始事件雜湊，以證明降低標籤維度沒有刪掉調查線索。
stages.descriptionEn: Loki identifies streams by label sets; promoting request IDs to labels can multiply index and memory pressure. Separate stable labels from high-churn fields and compare daily stream cardinality with audit searchability for two tenants. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Generate the complete ten-by-four-by-three label Cartesian product, placing one event in each combination, then create 200 request_id variants per combination. Preserve request_id in event content or suitable structured metadata, with original event hashes, so removing it from stream labels does not erase the information needed for a later investigation.
